release-validation.problem: Repeated manual build, test, preview, triage, and smoke validation
release-validation.reuse: Run the project-check or deployment-validation entry point before release and retain sanitized evidence.

sensitive-operation-safety.problem: Repeated approval, untrusted-content, secret-redaction, and destructive-action checks
sensitive-operation-safety.reuse: Route every sensitive or externally influenced operation through the existing fail-closed contracts.

operator-recovery.problem: Repeated health, connector, incident, credential, and recovery procedures
operator-recovery.reuse: Start from the operator runbook, preserve sanitized correlation evidence, and escalate live actions to the environment owner.

standalone-delivery.problem: Repeated need for no-Manus examples, task templates, and local operational reports
standalone-delivery.reuse: Use local deterministic examples and versioned templates as the default starting point outside Manus.

terminology-and-observability.problem: Repeated ambiguity in task, execution, artifact, connector, and event terminology
terminology-and-observability.reuse: Use canonical terms and correlation-safe structured events in new contracts, tests, and reports.
